name: focus-layout
title: Focused, collapsible layout
description: Keeps each section to its key idea, main box and widget; derivations, extra examples and quick checks fold away. Adds expand/collapse-all and opens folds that links point into.

toggle.description: Expand-all / collapse-all button in the top bar of pages with folds.

expandLabel.description: Toggle label when something is folded.

collapseLabel.description: Toggle label when everything is open.

openOnHash.description: Open the folds around a linked #target (and on in-page link clicks).

printOpen.description: Unfold everything while printing, then restore.

remember.description: Remember which folds a reader opened, per page.
